request.recipient: Intersect, with withdrawal directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, ecosystem coordination, and management of critical processes.

claims.claim: Intersect says the proposal funds its core operating model for June 2026 to June 2027, including governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, and critical unowned processes.

The requested budget is 25,400,000 ADA, allocated as 6,000,000 ADA for operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ADA for technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ADA for critical process management.
Intersect states that its overall ask has decreased from $7.875M last year to $6.35M this year while preserving functions it considers critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect claims it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting records, documentation, audited results, and an audit report.

The proposal states the requested amount does not, alone or in aggregate at submission time, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Intersect says independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.
The document discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA in Cardano treasury funding within the past 24 months through three listed governance actions.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, published addresses, multisignature authorization rules, and an oversight committee of six named external entities.
The proposal says a public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi will allow the community to audit the TRSC or PSSC and track metrics related to the withdrawn ADA, with activity also verifiable on-chain.

summary: The anchor requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect's June 2026 to June 2027 operating model, centered on governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, core repository coordination, and critical process management, with budget allocations, prior funding disclosure, voting references, smart-contract custody details, and assurance commitments provided in the document.
